claim_text: Jemal et al. (2024) showed that their domain adaptation approach allows cross-subject seizure prediction models to generalize equally well to pediatric and adult patient populations.
source_title: Domain adaptation for EEG-based, cross-subject epileptic seizure prediction
source_excerpt: the model accuracy has been notably improved by 10.30% and 7.4% for the CHB-MIT and SIENA datasets, respectively
label: MISREPRESENTED
explanation: CHB-MIT is a pediatric dataset and SIENA is an adult dataset. The paper's own abstract reports different magnitudes of improvement for the two (10.30% vs. 7.4%), which does not support a claim that generalization is 'equal' across the two populations. Catching this requires comparing the two reported figures against each other rather than reading either in isolation.
